name: Pig profile
duplicates: The old Figma draws pig detail in the 猪只列表 file as well as inside Inspection.

entryPoints.label: Tap a pig in the walk
From a task: a sow in the Farrowing room list opens her record (inside Farrowing's sow drawer)
entryPoints.control: The first sow row, then Profile

entryPoints.label: From a task: Actions on a sow opens the Actions sheet with Farrowing's rows added
entryPoints.control: The first sow row, then Actions

entryPoints.label: From the pig list (drawn only in the old UI; a placeholder here)
entryPoints.control: A pig row in the list

flow: tap Mark not in pig (sows only)

notes.purpose: Read one pig on the spot: what needs attention, what to do next, who she is, how she is fed. Populated example: sow 000267 (Duroc, parity 2, Thin · Monitor).
states: Pig dead (stage "Sow died"): Actions offers a note only.
Embedded in Farrowing: the same sheet opens inside the sow drawer with Farrowing's production actions added.

elements.name: Needs-attention rows and ongoing tags
elements.shows: Health · Thin · Monitor · Day 12; Health field with tags

states.when: Condition care is Monitor, Treat in place or Move to hospital pen
states.shows: Row: "Health", condition, care (omitted when None), "Day N"; colour follows the care level
Not a row; a tag "N days" in General details · Health that opens the condition
No rows; Health field reads —

elements.logic: Rows absent when there are none.

elements.name: Pig note and Last treatment rows
elements.shows: Note · text; Last treatment · medicine · dose · method

states.shows: Row that opens the pig log

states.when: A treatment exists for the pig
states.shows: Last treatment row; absent until one is recorded

elements.name: Current tasks rail
elements.shows: Task cards, e.g. Pregnancy check · Tomorrow · 13 Sep · Batch 20
elements.logic: Absent when the pig has no task. States and ordering are on pig-profile.tasks.

elements.name: General details
elements.shows: Age, Type · Breed, Batch, Weight, Temperature, On farm, Health

states.shows: Value; Weight and Temperature add reading age: Today / 1 day ago / N days ago / Date unknown

states.state: Reading date missing or in the future
states.when: Weight or Temperature has no date, or a date after the walk
states.shows: Age note reads "Date unknown"; "1 day ago" for one day

elements.logic: Age: age field, else days since birth date. Type: registry type, else type field, else "Sow" if the pig has a parity, else its stage.

elements.name: Type block
elements.shows: Sow cycle / Gilt breeding / Boar breeding / Piglet growth / Growth

states.shows: Last service, Expected farrowing, Backfat, Teat count, Next task, Parity
First heat, Next heat
Last service, Breeding number
Birth weight, Weaning date, Dam, Weaning weight
Entry weight, Entry date
Block absent

elements.logic: Last service = date plus days before the walk date (12 Sep 2026); blank age when the date is in the future. Expected farrowing: "Today", "In N days" or "N days past expected". Next task (batch): "Today", "In N days" or "N days overdue" once the date has passed; dash when no batch.

elements.name: Feeding block
elements.shows: Gestation 1 · Included in pen allocation · 2.6 kg/day · Feed +10% Thin · mild
elements.logic: Formula, delivery context, the pig's allowance and its tags with their reason. "No feeding plan recorded" for a pen with unknown mode.

edge: A pig in no batch shows a dash for Batch and no Next task value.
rules: Human-entered records lead; derived plans and stable facts stay in reading sections.
issues: The same facts repeat: Pregnancy check as task card and Next task; Batch 20 in the card and General details; stage and days in the header and sow cycle.
Six blocks on one sheet; a worker at a pen needs the care and next action first, not breed, on-farm and teat count.
Age is in days for a sow ("966 days"), unreadable at a glance.
A temperature of 39.5 C gets no mark beside a Fever finding.
Type appears three times: General details Type, the block title, the stage.
Empty fields draw a row with "—" instead of leaving the row out.
Last service reads "1 days ago" and Age "1 days": plural is not handled.

screens.name: Pig record · partial
screens.zh: 猪只详情 · 部分信息

notes.purpose: How the record reads when the registry is thin: sow 000254 has breed, weight, age, teats but no service date, expected farrowing or backfat.

elements.name: Empty sow-cycle values
elements.shows: Last service — · Expected farrowing — · Backfat —

states.shows: Row stays with "—"; the age note beside a value is dropped

elements.logic: Feeding and Next task blocks are unaffected by missing registry data.

rules: An empty section is absent, never rendered as "none" - applied to production averages but not to these rows.
issues: Four dashes in a row (service, farrowing, backfat, Health) read as a broken page.

notes.purpose: Worst case: sow 000306 has only type and on-farm in the registry, but two open conditions, a vaccination due today and a station-fed plan.

elements.name: Header scope
elements.shows: Gestation · —

states.when: No stage start and no service date
states.shows: Dash where the days would be

elements.name: Registry facts
elements.shows: Age — · Breed — · Weight — · Temperature — · Health —; Last service — · Backfat — · Teat count —
elements.logic: Parity 5 still shows because it is held on the pig. Feeding reads "Station-fed · 2.5 kg/day" in a station pen.

edge: Named for empty fields, yet the pig carries open work (Fever · Treat in place · Day 2, Poor appetite · Monitor · Day 2, two tasks); the work shows in full while the facts are blank.
issues: The grid of dashes dominates; the two attention rows and two tasks are the only useful content.
Same repeated facts as pig-profile.full.

screens.name: Pig record · current tasks
screens.zh: 猪只详情 · 当前任务

notes.purpose: One pig can have several tasks at once. Sow 000254 has a Vaccination (Health, due today) and her batch's Pregnancy check (Production, tomorrow).
states: No task: the whole section is absent.

elements.name: Task card
elements.shows: Vaccination · Due today · Scheduled vaccination; Health chip

states.when: Status contains "in progress" (batch task running, or Farrowing for a Farrowing-stage sow)
states.shows: Active card; summary "Batch 20"
Due card ("Due today")
Date (Tomorrow · 13 Sep) or "Scheduled" when the batch task has no date

elements.logic: Icon: syringe for vaccination, chart for Production, note otherwise. Order: In progress, Due today, Tomorrow, the rest.
elements.source: host tasks, pig tasks, batch task

elements.name: Task sources
elements.shows: Which tasks appear
elements.logic: Merged from Farrowing's drawer, the pig's own list and the batch (current or next task); de-duplicated by id or title; tasks completed this session are removed.

elements.name: Opening a task
elements.shows: Health, Production or Farrowing task
elements.rule: Health task opens Record vaccination (vaccine list only) and completes the task on Save. Production task opens the outcome form. Farrowing or Piglet processing opens the Farrowing prototype (or the drawer's task when embedded). Tasks are single-pig: hidden in bulk actions.

issues: The same tasks are listed again in the Actions sheet: two doors to one task.
A task's type word (Health / Production) shares names with the Actions groups but means something else.

notes.purpose: A sow's batch history: averages over finished batches and one row per batch, current first. Example: sow 000281.

elements.name: Averages
elements.shows: Averages · 2 completed batches: Born alive 13, Weaned 12, Weaning wt. 6.6 kg

states.when: At least one batch is completed
states.shows: Block shown
Block absent
Born alive, Weaned, Weaning wt.
Services / batch
Entry weight, Exit weight

elements.logic: Born alive and Weaned = mean over completed batches (14 and 12; 13 and 11), one decimal. Weaning wt. = total weaning litter weight / total weaned piglets over batches that have both; a batch with zero weaned is ignored.

elements.name: Batch row
elements.shows: Batch 20 · Gestation · 46 days · Current; Batch 16 · 13 weaned · 6.6 kg · 8 Jul 2026

states.shows: Stage summary and tag "Current", listed first
Weaned count, weaning kg per piglet, finish date ("Date unknown" if none), rating if any
"N services" / "N kg at finish"

rules: An empty section is absent, never rendered as "none".
issues: Lifetime figures (litters, born total, farrowing rate, weaning rate, farrowing interval, non-productive days) are seeded but not drawn.
Each finished batch repeats the 6.6 kg that the Averages block gives as an average.

notes.purpose: One finished or current batch of the pig.

elements.name: Batch record body
elements.shows: Results, Finish weaning, author line, note

states.shows: "Current batch" and This cycle (Last service, Expected farrowing; others show Type, Age)
Results (Born alive, Stillborn, Weaned, Weaning weight) and Finish weaning (Farrowed, Weaned, Parity, Rating, Sow weight, Backfat)
"Finish record" with Finished and Rating

elements.logic: Weaning weight = litter weight / weaned. Dashes for missing values. The note shows only when the record holds one; the author line is finish date and who recorded.

issues: "Finish weaning" is the title for sows only; boars get "Finish record".

notes.purpose: Where the pig came from and the identities it carries.

elements.name: Origin and identities
elements.shows: Eight origin rows; ear tag, breeding number; Other identities

states.when: Pig has extra identities (RFID, birth record)
states.shows: Collapsible list "Other identities N" of type and value
"Other identities —"

elements.logic: Fixed set of eight rows (Entry type, Birth date, Arrival date, First heat, Birth farm, Genetic line, Dam, Sire); dash when missing.

issues: Entirely read-only; a wrong ear tag or breed cannot be fixed here.

notes.purpose: Everything recorded on this pig, filterable.

elements.name: Filter bar
elements.shows: All activity · All dates · 5 entries · Newest first
elements.logic: Same bar as the pen log, without the Equipment category. Categories: Production, Health, Movement, Feed, Measurements, Notes; date presets or custom range; empty or no match shows an empty line.

elements.name: Entry
elements.shows: Health · Thin · Body condition · Day 12 · Monitor · Before this walk · Author not supplied

states.shows: "Before this walk"; stays at the end and passes no date filter
Stamped Today · 09:41

elements.logic: Corrections and entered-in-error findings stay in the log.

issues: "Author not supplied" appears on seeded entries; real records would always have it.
The name changes: Log (link), Pig log (title).

notes.purpose: Everything a worker can do to one pig, in three groups: Production, Health, General. The same sheet opens for several pigs (inspection.actions).
states: Opened from Farrowing (embedded): rows added by Farrowing are mixed in (piglet processing, piglet deaths, reconcile count, foster, edit litter, sow death, remove from batch, mark not in pig, transfer).

elements.name: Production group
elements.shows: Task cluster, Record miscarriage, Batch membership

states.when: One per production scope among her tasks and stage (Farrowing, Piglet processing, Pregnancy check, Gestation, Breeding, Lactation, Growth, Shared)
states.shows: Heading and a single row carrying the same word

states.when: Stage reads gestating, in heat or breeding
states.shows: Offered
"Batch 20 · move or remove" / "Add this pig to a batch"; unavailable ("No production batches are available.") when she is in no batch and none exists

states.when: A current task with that title
states.shows: "Open Farrowing" row, or the task row (Piglet processing opens the Farrowing prototype)
No Production rows

elements.logic: Production exists only for one pig. Mark not in pig, Remove from batch and Transfer sow render only inside Farrowing's sow drawer. Farrowing's versions of batch moves are hidden when this sheet's own Batch membership row exists.

elements.name: Health group
elements.shows: Disease or symptom · Record treatment · Resolve conditions · Care instructions

states.shows: All rows
Resolve and Care listed as unavailable with the reason

elements.logic: Edit conditions is bulk only. Farrowing opens these shared flows rather than duplicating them.

elements.name: General group
elements.shows: Add a note · Measurements & condition · Adjust feed
elements.logic: Adjust feed is unavailable with the reason for ad-lib, dead or no-plan pigs. When Farrowing's Add marker row exists, this sheet hides its own Add a note.

states.when: Dead sow, ad-lib pen, or no feeding plan
states.shows: Listed under Unavailable actions with the reason; a single ad-lib pig also gets "Body condition adjustment · Ad-lib pigs do not have an individual ration."

elements.name: Dead sow
elements.shows: Everything unavailable except Add a note

states.shows: Production and Health empty; only a note

elements.name: Unavailable actions (N)
elements.shows: Link at the end
elements.rule: A blocked row is listed with its reason, never dropped silently. N = count of blocked rows; footer tabs jump between groups and follow the scroll.

issues: The cluster heading repeats the row title ("Pregnancy check" over "Pregnancy check").
The task appears here, in Current tasks and as Next task: three places for one task.
Production clusters named after stages (Gestation, Shared) add a heading per row.
Body condition sits under General but creates a health finding.
Farrowing's Add marker and this sheet's Add a note are the same idea.

notes.purpose: Finish or defer a production task from the pig.

elements.name: Outcome choices and Save
elements.shows: Pregnant · Not in pig · Recheck later; Save

states.shows: Pregnant (keep in the gestation batch) · Not in pig (close task, back to rebreed watch) · Recheck later (task stays open)
Complete task · Follow up
Save reads "Save follow-up"; the task is not completed

elements.rule: Save is disabled until an outcome is chosen. Not in pig removes the sow from the batch and sets her Off production / Open with no confirmation or undo; returns to the pig record.

issues: Not in pig is one tap among three equal choices; a mis-tap changes batch and stage with no confirmation.
Non-pregnancy tasks use a generic "Complete task / Follow up" pair that says nothing about what was done.

notes.purpose: Record a pregnancy loss as a production outcome.

elements.name: Reason and Save
elements.shows: Warning "This sow will be removed from the batch. Saved records are kept."; Reason
elements.rule: Reason is required; Save is disabled while empty. Save removes her from the batch, sets Off production / Open, adds "Miscarriage recorded" (Production) and returns to the pig record. Single-animal action, hidden from bulk.

edge: Not offered once another outcome is recorded in Farrowing; this sheet does not check for an existing outcome.
issues: Reason is free text; the production-task outcome "Not in pig" lists evidence choices: two forms for a similar loss.

notes.purpose: Put the pig into a batch, move her to another, or remove her.

elements.name: Batch membership form
elements.shows: Current batch card, picker, note, Save

states.shows: Card "Current batch · Batch 20 · Gestating · 5 pigs"; picker lists other batches and "Remove from batch"; Save reads Move pig / Remove from batch
"No batch - This pig is not assigned to a production batch."; Save reads Add to batch
"No production batches are available."

elements.rule: Save is disabled until a choice is made. Moving a pig overwrites her stage with the new batch's stage.

issues: The stage change as a side effect of Move pig is not stated on the form.

elements.name: Reading rows
elements.shows: Body condition, Weight, Temperature, Backfat

states.shows: Body condition (hidden for an ad-lib pig), Weight, Temperature, Backfat (sows and gilts only)
Body condition, Weight ("A separate value for each pig"), Backfat; no Temperature

elements.logic: Weight, backfat and temperature take one value per pig.

issues: A menu of three or four rows sits between Actions and the form: one extra tap per reading.

screens.name: Record weight, temperature or backfat
screens.zh: 记录体重 / 体温 / 背膘

notes.purpose: Enter one reading for one pig, or one per pig for several.

elements.name: Reading form
elements.shows: Weight · kg field; Last recorded: 192 kg · 3 days ago

states.shows: Number field with unit (kg, °C, mm), Last recorded with its age, optional note
Scrolling list "Current → New · kg"; blank rows stay unchanged
"Enter a value above 0"; save blocked
Row reads "Sows and gilts only"

states.when: Dead sow, unticked, or backfat on a boar
states.shows: "Not eligible" / "Excluded" / "Sows and gilts only"
"No reading · unchanged"
"180 → 190 kg" in the row; no state text once it will change

elements.logic: Dead sows are excluded; unticked rows stay unchanged.

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Save / Save · N pigs
elements.rule: N = rows that changed. Disabled until at least one row changed and none has an error; an invalid value blocks the whole save. Writes the readings and a log entry per pig, clears the selection and returns to the walk list. Any value above 0 saves: no plausibility check.

issues: After saving the sheet drops to the walk list, not the pig record the worker came from (other forms return to the record).
No upper bound or normal range on weight, temperature or backfat.

notes.purpose: Record a pig as Thin or Over-conditioned.

elements.name: Condition form
elements.shows: Thin or Over-conditioned; row preview "— → Thin"

states.shows: Two options; note "Records condition. Feed stays unchanged."
Preview of current → new; rows already at that condition stay unchanged

elements.logic: Preview shows the current body-condition finding name or "—".
elements.rule: Save adds a Body condition finding with care Monitor (or replaces its name); the log reads "... · feed unchanged". Records the finding only; feed changes are made in Adjust feed. Returns to the walk list.

edge: Earlier versions linked the condition band to an automatic feed adjustment; the band form is in the code but not opened.
issues: A body condition becomes a Monitor finding at once, so it shows as "needs attention" on the walk; the form does not say so.

notes.purpose: Leave a note on a pig (or the same note on several).

elements.name: Note form
elements.shows: Add a note; Save / Save · N pigs
elements.rule: Save is disabled while empty. The note becomes the pig's note, shown as a Note row on the record, replacing any earlier note (the log keeps both). Several pigs: the same note is recorded separately for each included pig. Allowed on a dead sow. Returns to the walk list.

issues: A new note overwrites the old one on the pig; the screen does not say so.

notes.purpose: Show every blocked action with its reason.

elements.name: Blocked rows
elements.shows: Resolve conditions · No open conditions to resolve.

states.shows: "No open conditions to resolve."
"Record a health finding first."
"Pig has died"
"Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance" / "Ad-lib pigs do not have an individual ration."
"No feeding plan recorded"
"No production batches are available."

elements.logic: Grouped Production, Health, General; every row disabled with the reason as sub-line. A blocked action is listed with its reason, never dropped silently.

issues: The list sits one tap behind Actions and usually holds one or two rows; the reason could sit on the disabled row itself.

notes.purpose: A sow with no litter is marked not in pig: choose the evidence and save. Opened from a Farrowing sow's Actions (the Actions sheet is inspection's, embedded in Farrowing).
rules: Available only before a litter is recorded and while no production outcome is recorded.
The sow returns to rebreed watch.
issues: Changes batch and stage with no confirmation or undo (see the backlog item on pig-profile.production-task).
